title: Repeat order: same buyer, same style and colours as an open order, different PO and date
subject: New PO BWA-51002 – BW-TS-204 repeat (Spring 2)
body:
Hi Karthik,

The BW-TS-204 tee did so well that we're placing a repeat for our Spring 2 drop. PO BWA-51002 attached – same tee, same colors, later date.

Thanks,
Megan
Brightwater Apparel Inc.
